register.labelZh: BEAR 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: bear down on 可以描述車輛、風暴、人群或其他危險迅速逼近某人或某處。；bear on 可以表示某項事實、規則、決定或意見與特定主題或情況有關,並可能造成影響。；當事實、訊息、結果或其他人支持某人的說法時,可以使用 bear somebody out。；bear up 表示在困難中保持堅強;bear with 則用來請別人耐心等候。
register.summaryEn: Bear down on can describe a vehicle, storm, crowd or other danger moving quickly towards someone or somewhere. Bear on can show that a fact, rule, decision or comment affects a particular subject or situation. Bear somebody out can be used when facts, messages, results or other people support what someone has said. Bear up describes remaining strong during difficulty, while bear with asks someone to wait patiently.
